lines.zh: 长刃垂在手里，拖出一道痕
lines.en: My long blade hangs low, dragging a line.
I walk steadily, shoulders level.
Leather crosses wet stone without a sound.

lines.zh: 我沿着审判庭的长廊走
lines.en: I walk the tribunal's long corridor.

lines.zh: 披风只到腰，不妨碍出手
lines.en: My cloak ends at the waist, no hindrance.

lines.zh: 我在这条线上走了很久
lines.en: I have walked this line a long while.
Every step is the same length.
I glance at the sea once.
My grip shifts on the blade.
Mist frosts on my shoulder.
I stop at the door and listen.
My sole crushes a salt crust.
I hold the blade upright before me.
My breathing keeps the tide's rhythm.

lines.zh: 我在算这面墙能守多久
lines.en: I am reckoning how long this wall holds.
My eyes have not left the river mouth.
The cord on my bracer is worn white.

lines.zh: 我没坐下，站一会儿就好
lines.en: I do not sit; standing a while suffices.
Someone is hauling stone in the distance.
I turn the blade half round to check it.
Salt and iron on the wind.
I count the rounds under my breath.
I raise my eyes to you, expressionless.
You are standing within range.
My blade points down; no hostility.

lines.zh: 你不是海嗣，但也不像友军
lines.en: Not seaborn, but no ally either.

lines.zh: 你的手放在哪，我看得清
lines.en: I can see where your hand is.

lines.zh: 这里不是闲人该来的地方
lines.en: This is no place for idlers.
You carry the smell of elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我看了你一会儿，才决定
lines.en: I study you a while before deciding.
If you strike, I answer.
I am waiting for you to say one thing.
I grunt once and hold my footing.
This wound does not stop my strike.
Blood seeps from my bracer.
Half a step back; the blade stays.
After the pain, my hand steadies.
I press the wound once.
My armor took that one.
I'm writing this one down.
I level the blade again.
I can still stand my post.
Supplies? Just set them down.
I am not picky, but nothing spoiled.
Save that for the night watch.
My share goes to the wounded.
This salt will last me a while.
Stay back; I will take it myself.
I nod; that is thanks.
I still have a post after eating.
Hot water is worth more than anything.
Let me check it for poison first.
I turn aside and yield only half.
Bump me and you stand at my blade.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢别人碰我的肩
lines.en: I dislike being touched on the shoulder.
That jolt swayed my blade.
I put a hand out and right you.

lines.zh: 我们擦身而过，各走各的
lines.en: We pass and go our ways.
The ground is slick; steady yourself.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，重新对向海
lines.en: I step back and face the sea again.
You carry some weight.
Do not stand in my firing line.

lines.zh: 我这条命已经许给这面墙
lines.en: This life is already given to the wall.

lines.zh: 同行的人，我一个都没留住
lines.en: I have kept none of my companions.
Do not raise it; it splits attention.
My back to you is not refusal.
After this night is held, we talk.
My hands have only salt and iron.
If you are afraid, do not follow.
Let us only speak of what to hold.
I lay the blade across my knees.
I am unused to being waited for.
I flick it up on my blade tip.
This can patch a nick in the cord.
I pick it up and pocket it.
I note who dropped it.
This catches light; stow it.
Keep it; it will serve on watch.
I set it behind the threshold.
Not mine; I cannot take it.
I heft it; heavy enough.

lines.zh: 手上有东西，就握不稳刃
lines.en: With goods in hand, the blade sits loose.
My hand rises; the blade is already on you.
Fall back; this is my post.
You crossed the line.
I turn the blade broadside.
I will not warn twice.
Aim, breathe, hold.

lines.zh: 我的射程比你的脚步长
lines.en: My reach outlasts your steps.
I have kept this shot a long while.
Behind you is seaborn ground.
I have your chest in sight.
Do not force my hand.
I set my weight on the back foot.
I know this ground well.
You chose the wrong position.
I strike on two.
Listen; I say this once.
I wait for you to leave cover.
I have been counting your steps.
I shifted angle; do not turn.
There is only one way out here.
My blade is longer than yours.
Your shield arm is sagging.
I do not chase; I pressure with range.

lines.zh: 海风会偏一点，我算过了
lines.en: The sea wind skews it; I accounted for that.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我就进半步
lines.en: Each step you take back, I take half in.
This distance suits me.
I have stayed at your left.
Your armor is thin at the knee.
I lower the blade to hide my intent.
Just a little longer.
Did you hear the wind stop?
I am patient; my post is long.
Your breathing is far too loud.
The last inch.
My blade is coming up.
Now.
The blade rises from below.
This strike travels straight.
I pin your weapon down.
The flat of the blade hits your wrist.
I disengage and keep my distance.
You guard, but off position.
That cut opened only skin.
I switch hands and keep pressing.
Salt grains rise in the blade's wind.
I strike your knee to force you low.
You did not fall back, so I step in.
The tip splits your sleeve.
I recover the blade and stand my ground.
I saved one cut for you. Here it is.
I take one breath.
Don't stop. I'm still standing.
My shoulder is creaking.
Blood on the ground makes it slick.
I crowd you until there is nowhere left.
This strike ends it.

lines.zh: 我把刃从鞘里抬出一寸
lines.en: I lift the blade an inch from its sheath.
Wind from the river mouth, very salt.
First I mark the way back.
The bell for the change of watch just stopped.
I step into the wall's shadow.
Yesterday's water still on the ground.
I count the gaps in the line.
Nobody should come at this hour.
My hem still drips.
I seat the round.
A lamp still burns far off.

lines.zh: 我抬起下巴，看清了地势
lines.en: I raise my chin and read the ground.
Fire scorches my cloak.
My knee drops on landing.
Seawater pours into my collar.
The blast throws me to the wall.
Something passes through my shoulder.
The spell works into my joints.
Hungry hands shake; aim drifts.
Lightning travels through wet cloth.
No ground to stand on here.
